issues.claim: "Anyone typing the old address lands on a page offering the domain for sale" (audit_md, What it means for customers) and "the address on your old site, huakangskincare.com, now redirects to a GoDaddy page offering the domain for sale" (founder_md outreach email)
issues.problem: Not what the live page says. Opened https://huakangskincare.com/ today: the visible text is only the domain name, 'is parked free, courtesy of GoDaddy.com', a 'Get This Domain' button, six 'Related Search Topics' links and a GoDaddy copyright/disclaimer line. The words 'for sale' and any price are absent. The 'Get This Domain' button points at godaddy.com/domainsearch/find?...domainToCheck=huakangskincare.com (a domain-availability search), not a listing page. Meanwhile RDAP shows the name still registered to 2027-03-27 with client delete/renew/transfer/update prohibited, and the auditor's own data_gaps say it is unknown 'whether huakangskincare.com has a buyer, is formally listed for sale, or is simply an unused domain'. So 'offering the domain for sale' is an unlabelled inference that the audit's own gaps contradict - and it is the sentence the consultant would say to the owner on the phone.
issues.fix: Reword both to the observable fact, e.g. 'a GoDaddy parking page with a "Get This Domain" button; the domain itself is still registered through 2027, so whether it can actually be bought is unclear'. Keep 'for sale' out unless a source says so.

issues.claim: "the archived site said 10:00-21:00 daily" (severity_reason and caveats)
issues.problem: The archived page does not say that. Opened https://web.archive.org/web/20240229065606/https://www.huakangskincare.com/: 'Hours of Operation are: Monday~Sunday: 10:00 PM ~ 9:00 PM' - internally contradictory times. Reading that as 10:00-21:00 assumes the 'PM' is a typo for 'AM'; the same sentence also appears in the 2014-11-22 capture. The audit's own caveat already says none of the hours are the business's current statement, but the 10:00-21:00 rendering is presented as what the page said.
issues.fix: Either quote it as it stands ('the archived site shows a garbled "10:00 PM ~ 9:00 PM" line, probably 10 AM-9 PM') or drop the archived hours from the comparison and rely on Google 9 PM vs BestProsInTown 9 PM vs SpaAndParlor 7 PM.

issues.claim: Body length of audit_md (limit: at most 300 words)
issues.problem: The body runs to about 314 words counting headings (about 295 excluding headings), so it is at or just over the limit depending on how headings are counted.
issues.fix: Cut roughly 20 words - e.g. drop the '(screenshots saved)' note and shorten the 'What it means for customers' paragraph - so it is comfortably under 300.
